_metadata.description: A valid .d sidecar paired with its (untampered) source .d, but the sidecar's payload.key_id has been relabeled to a different (still well-formed) value. The verifying_key embedded in the sidecar is unchanged. The verifier MUST derive the key id from verifying_key (NOT from payload.key_id) and refuse the sidecar because the label and the actual signer disagree. The reference verifier raises MalformedSidecar at this check, mapped to SIDECAR_ERROR (3).
